lines.trans: The show has been taken off the air for overhaul.
Senior executives have been in a meeting inside for several hours already.
I heard the chairwoman flew back overnight too; nothing like this ever happened before.
You are Bu Xiaogu, right?
Yes, I am.
In Xingtian's history, nobody has ever been led out by police, do you know that?
That was the finale night of Twelve Singers.
How things stand with you no longer matters; Xingtian will certainly dismiss you.
The reason is a major public-relations incident.
Under company rules, my signature as public-relations director takes immediate effect.
